diff --git a/ingest/records.py b/ingest/records.py
index 5b30cca..fe18c11 100644
--- a/ingest/records.py
+++ b/ingest/records.py
@@ -7,4 +7,10 @@ Unknown keys are dropped.
 
 
 def normalize(record: dict) -> dict:
-    return dict(record)
+    normalized = {}
+    for key, value in record.items():
+        snake_key = key.lower().replace("_", "-").replace("-", "_").replace(" ", "_")
+        if snake_key in normalized:
+            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate key encountered: {snake_key}")
+        normalized[snake_key] = value
+    return normalized
